items.question: What qualifications must the officiating preceptor possess for the ritual?
premises: The officiating preceptor must be present for the ritual.
The preceptor must possess a very serene mind.
The preceptor must be born in a Śiva-brahmin family.
items.inference: Only a serene-minded preceptor born in a Śiva-brahmin family is qualified to officiate.
uncertainties: The precise scope of śivadvija as a specific lineage designation is not fully specified here.
items.plain_english: The preceptor, very serene in mind and born in a family of Śiva-brahmins, should officiate.
